dialogue.speaker: host
dialogue.text: Right. Order blocks. Let us clear this up, step by step.

dialogue.speaker: host
dialogue.text: An order block is the last opposing candle before a strong move. That is where the big institutional orders went in.

dialogue.speaker: host
dialogue.text: Here is the chart. Watch the shape, not the noise.

dialogue.speaker: host
dialogue.text: This red candle is the order block. The final down candle before price rips higher.

dialogue.speaker: host
dialogue.text: That one candle is the footprint. Institutions filled their buy orders there, then left.

dialogue.speaker: host
dialogue.text: Now the part that matters. Price usually comes back to retest that zone.

dialogue.speaker: host
dialogue.text: The retest is your entry. You are buying where the institutions bought.

dialogue.speaker: host
dialogue.text: Your stop goes below the low of the block. If price closes under it, the idea is invalid.

dialogue.speaker: host
dialogue.text: A bearish order block is the mirror image. The last green candle before a sharp drop. You sell the retest.

dialogue.speaker: host
dialogue.text: Three rules. Wait for the displacement. Mark the zone. Only take the retest.

dialogue.speaker: host
dialogue.text: And none of this is a guarantee. Order blocks fail. Size your risk so that when one does, you are still trading tomorrow.
